text:
mina_ml: heads up — during ari-compact-int8 bringup I hit a reproducible "boundary shadowing" on sinitic compounds (we're seeing subtoken merges that change translation meaning). BLEU on zh->en eval dropped ~2.3 relative to fp16 baseline. sample below.

li_zhang: which eval set + model config? can you paste the inputs/outputs?

mina_ml: repro id 2026-03-22-ari-int8-shadow. model: ari-compact v2 quant=int8 per-channel, kl-symmetric, kernels=auto. tokenizer v2026-02-18. eval: small-sinic-translate (1.2k pairs). example: 
```
input: "臺灣話 比 台語 更 豐富 的 語彙"
fp16 output: "Taiwanese has a richer vocabulary than Taiwanese dialects."
int8 output: "Taiwanesehasaricher vocabulary than Taiwanese dialects."
// note: fused subtoken removed space -> tokenization boundary collapsed
```

ken_ops: wow — looks like subtoken boundary glue (no spaces). did you check tokenizer normalization / pretokenizer? could be vocab remapping during quant conversion.

mina_ml: checked. token maps identical, detokenized strings differ. ran tokenizer.roundtrip on inputs and it matched. suspect the runtime kv-cache or attention kernel quant rounding at boundary lengths (1-3 subtokens) — reproduced locally with small harness.

eva_research: this smells like kv-cache numeric truncation causing mask index misalignment for short-prefix tokens. quick test: run inference with `RT_KV_FP16=true` or runtime flag `--force-fp16-kv` and see if output matches fp16.

mina_ml: tried `--force-fp16-kv` on the same shard: BLEU recovered from -2.3 -> -0.7 (still some delta) and the fused-space disappearance is gone for the sample. latency +9ms p50.

li_zhang: ok that confirms kv quant pathway is the likely culprit. can you dump the kv tensors for failing case and attach to repro ticket? i'll triage kernel selection.

mina_ml: attaching in the ticket (link: https://redwood.internal/issue/ARI-INT8-487). also adding a tiny fuzz harness to catch boundary-shadowing cases.

ken_ops: for Dedicated/on-prem customers we should gate int8 by a perf/quality flag until kernel fix. i'll add an opt-out in the quant-recommendation that enforces fp16-kv for mixed-orient locales.

ci-bot: started CI run for 2026-03-22-ari-int8-shadow on eng-ml/ari-compact-int8 (builders x3). job: #2941.

eva_research: follow-up experiment idea: run int8 but with pretokenizer soft-split (insert zero-width space between ambiguous grapheme sequences) as a temporary quality mitigant. could be added to Optimize suggestions for affected locales.

mina_ml: agreed. i've pushed a short PR with fuzz harness + example cases. will monitor CI. :thumbsup:
